name: Custom-Forged Weapon
priceText: Per ±1 Min STR: B +300G, A +1,000G, S +3,000G, SS +6,000G (CR III p.246)
summary: Raise or lower a weapon's Min STR by up to 3; its Power changes by the same amount.
description: A weapon can be forged with Min STR changed by up to ±3 from the listed value (never below 1); Power changes by the same amount. Guns cannot be custom-forged. The cost per point is added to the price; modifying an owned weapon takes one week. Name: 'Custom-Forged <weapon>' or any name.

name: Silvered Weapon
summary: Buy a weapon silvered: it bypasses [Normal Weapon Immunity] and can hit silver weak points.
description: Silvered weapons ignore the [Normal Weapon Immunity] unique skill and trigger silver-related weak points. Only available when buying the weapon (owned weapons cannot be re-forged); weapons already marked Silvered cannot be silvered again. Name prefix 'Silvered'.

name: Magic Weapon +1
priceText: B +5,000G, A +10,000G, S +20,000G; not available for SS rank (CR III p.246)
summary: Weapon gains Accuracy +1 and Extra Damage +1 and becomes a magic weapon.
description: The weapon gains +1 to Accuracy checks and +1 Extra Damage (its damage stays physical). Can be bought with the weapon or applied to an owned one in one month; not possible for items that are already magic weapons. Name suffix '+1'.

name: Fairy Weapon
summary: Weapon becomes magic; a password (Minor Action) adds a chosen element type to its damage.
description: The weapon counts as a Magic Weapon. Speaking its password as a Minor Action gives its damage the type chosen at enhancement time (earth, water/ice, fire, wind or lightning) until another password is spoken. Can be applied several times for more types (one active at a time); each application takes one month. Name prefix 'Fairy (<types>)'.

name: Magic Armor +1
priceText: B +5,000G, A +10,000G, S +20,000G; not available for SS rank (CR III p.246)
summary: Nonmetallic or metal armor gains Defense +1.
description: Armor Defense +1. Only for nonmetallic or metal armor, not shields, and not for items that are already magical. Applying it to owned armor takes one month. Name suffix '+1'.

name: Bulletproof Armor
summary: Armor's Defense also reduces Gun and Magic Arrow damage, up to 6 times.
description: When the wearer is hit by a Gun shooting attack or a Magic Arrow/Quarrel, the damage is reduced by the armor's own Defense (no feat or temporary bonuses). Works 6 times; used charges can be restored for 250/500/1,000G (B/A/S rank) each, one day per charge. New enhancement takes one week. Nonmetallic or metal armor only. Name prefix 'Bulletproofed'.

name: Ignidite Processing
priceText: B +5,000G, A +10,000G, S +20,000G, SS +40,000G; also 100 reputation and a Dark Dwarf Blacksmith connection
summary: Weapon Power +5 (SS rank +10) and it becomes a magic weapon.
description: The weapon's Power increases by +5 (+10 for SS rank) and it counts as a magic weapon (damage stays physical). Requires spending 100 reputation and a Dark Dwarf Blacksmith acquaintance; processing takes one week and such weapons are never sold ready-made. Name prefix 'Ignidite'.

name: Extra Manatite Armor
priceText: B +5,000G, A +10,000G, S +20,000G, SS +30,000G (metal armor or shield)
summary: Metal armor or shield: Min STR +3 and Defense +1.
description: Manatite plating raises the item's Min STR by 3 and its Defense by 1. Only for metal armor and shields. Can be bought processed or applied to an owned item in one week. Name prefix 'Manatite'.
